name: Kaito Shizuki
description: Kaito Shizuki is a Kamigawan planeswalker and former Imperial trainee with telekinetic powers, who fights with a katana and shuriken and is accompanied by the kami Himoto.

summary.text: Kaito Shizuki is a Kamigawan planeswalker and former Imperial trainee with telekinetic powers, who fights with a katana and shuriken and is accompanied by the kami Himoto.

bio.text: Working for Satoru without a loyalty mark, Kaito was set up to find Tameshi, and when Himoto bonded with the tanuki prototype he donned its mask and became a planeswalker.
When the emperor vanished he hunted the man with the metal arm, was told by dying Tameshi the name Tezzeret, and teamed with Tamiyo and stole the Reality Chip.
He and Tamiyo walked into Tezzeret's trap at the lab, but the Wanderer, his childhood friend, freed them, and after the battle he left to master planeswalking and find Tamiyo and the emperor.
He joined the strike team on New Phyrexia, where he lifted Phyrexian oil from the group and helped Kaya stop Jace from using the sylex.
Back on Kamigawa during the invasion, he climbed Boseiju to confront the compleated Tamiyo, who overpowered him before he cut himself free.
He refused Elesh Norn's offer to join the One, and later led the rescue of Nashi in the House, where Jace abandoned him in a gel pit and he planeswalked to Ravnica.
He returned through an artificial Omenpath and stabbed Valgavoth before the team escaped to Ravnica.

status.text: As of the latest story, Kaito is alive and has escaped the House with the team onto Ravnica.

timeline.summary: Kaito stalks a gambler through the crowded Lantern Festival for a Reckoner job.
timeline.quote: It hadn't taken Kaito long to find his target.

timeline.summary: Kaito reflects that it has been a year since the emperor went missing, the night he chased a stranger out of Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: It had only been a year since the emperor went missing.

timeline.summary: Kaito picks the gambler's pocket and clears the job on his comm.
timeline.quote: Kaito reached into the man's coat and retrieved his wallet.

timeline.summary: In the Undercity a Reckoner accuses Kaito of stealing his mark, and Kaito talks him down.
timeline.quote: "You stole my mark."

timeline.summary: Kaito reveals he joined the Reckoners to find the man with a metal arm who attacked the emperor.
timeline.quote: If anyone was going to know about a man with a metal arm, it would be Satoru's spies.

timeline.summary: Satoru's channeler, possessed by Azamaki, summons Kaito to see Satoru.
timeline.quote: "Satoru wishes to speak with you,"

timeline.summary: Satoru questions Kaito's loyalty, noting he has no loyalty mark.
timeline.quote: "Yet you have no loyalty mark."

timeline.summary: Satoru assigns Kaito an off-list job: steal the schematics of the moonfolk Futurist Tameshi.
timeline.quote: I want you to bring me the schematics.

timeline.summary: Kaito learns Tameshi has moved his research to the Boseiju District and enlists his sister Eiko as a diplomat to guide him.
timeline.quote: Kaito lifted his head to find his sister standing several feet away.

timeline.summary: Eiko sets rules, including no weapons, and Kaito explains he is working for the Reckoners for the emperor's sake.
timeline.quote: "I'm doing this for the emperor,"

timeline.summary: Eiko speaks with the Kodama of the West Tree and gains safe passage but conceals the threat of Tameshi.
timeline.quote: "She says we can pass through safely, as long as we don't go beyond the river,"

timeline.summary: Kaito draws his dagger at a rock kami and Eiko scolds him for breaking the no-weapons rule.
timeline.quote: "I thought we agreed no weapons,"

timeline.summary: Eiko confesses she saw a light on the roof the night the emperor vanished, which exploded and became an animal.
timeline.quote: It wasn't a man—it was a light.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Eiko reconcile over Light-Paws's disbelief, and Eiko offers to bring him home.
timeline.quote: "You can still come home, you know.

timeline.summary: Eiko turns back at the river, and Kaito crosses alone and finds Tameshi's makeshift laboratory with a caged something.
timeline.quote: Not a box—a cage . And there was something trapped inside.

timeline.summary: Tameshi ambushes Kaito and they fight with Tameshi's origami staff; Kaito pins Tameshi's throat with the staff.
timeline.quote: until he managed to pull the rod against his opponent's throat.

timeline.summary: Eiko stops Kaito from strangling Tameshi.
timeline.quote: "Kaito, what are you doing? Let him go!"

timeline.summary: Tameshi recognizes Kaito's crane drone and reveals that Katsumasa was his mentor and that they designed it together.
timeline.quote: "He was my mentor.

timeline.summary: The caged object turns out to be a metal tanuki robot, which Eiko recognizes as resembling the animal she saw.
timeline.quote: "This robot is almost identical to the animal I saw."

timeline.summary: Tameshi explains the light was a unique kami being born, embodying the emperor's bond with Kyodai, and that he built the prototype to protect it.
timeline.quote: "The light you saw was a kami being born.

timeline.summary: Kaito hears Kyodai's voice and runs after it hoping the emperor has returned, but finds only the tanuki-shaped kami.
timeline.quote: Instead, he saw the tanuki-shaped kami, with glowing white eyes and translucent fur.

timeline.summary: Five Hyozan Reckoners led by Nari arrive with Satoru's channeler, revealing they were watching Kaito and that the job was a setup to find Tameshi.
timeline.quote: He hoped you'd lead us to Tameshi."

timeline.summary: Eiko breaks free and the siblings fight the Reckoners back to back while Tameshi fails to make the kami merge with the robot.
timeline.quote: "What happened to 'no weapons'?"

timeline.summary: The Order of Jukai arrives and battles the Reckoners, letting the group escape with the kami.
timeline.quote: The Order of Jukai had arrived.

timeline.summary: Gravelighter attacks the fleeing group; Kaito shields Eiko and Himoto, and Himoto commands Gravelighter to retreat.
timeline.quote: No—not a cry. A command .

timeline.summary: Tameshi reveals he stalled and sent a drone to summon the Order of Jukai, and Eiko offers him a deal to abandon the research.
timeline.quote: I was stalling, waiting for the Order of Jukai to turn up.

timeline.summary: Tameshi gives Kaito his tanuki drone and departs to clear his lab.
timeline.quote: "Take it. It's far better than that outdated crane you've been holding onto."

timeline.summary: Himoto refuses to go to the palace with Eiko; Kaito names her Pompon-chan and vows to find the emperor.
timeline.quote: "I vote we call her Pompon-chan for now,"

timeline.summary: Himoto bonds with the tanuki prototype and tells Kaito her name.
timeline.quote: "She says her name is Himoto."

timeline.summary: Kaito dons the tanuki mask and feels a surge of power, and Kaito vanishes from Kamigawa as a new planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Kaito took a step forward and vanished from Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, returns to Towashi in his mask, resolved to keep searching the Multiverse for the emperor.
timeline.quote: There were many more planes to search.

timeline.summary: Kaito sneaks into the palace kitchen and uses telekinesis to steal blue mochi, escaping a cook after breaking dishes.
timeline.quote: Two pieces of mochi floated up in the air, hovering inches above the table.

timeline.summary: Kaito shares a mochi with Eiko in the sparring room before Light-Paws arrives.
timeline.quote: "Don't be mad."

timeline.summary: Light-Paws announces Kaito and Eiko will no longer be sparring partners, because Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.
timeline.quote: Eiko has chosen to study as a kami diplomat.

timeline.summary: Kaito recalls how he first befriended the emperor, speaking to her behind a screen door without knowing who she was.
timeline.quote: Kaito hadn't known it was the emperor.

timeline.summary: Swift-Arm introduces Kaito's new sparring partner, who is the emperor, and Kaito sees her face for the first time.
timeline.quote: The Emperor of Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Kaito spars with the emperor and she disarms him, smiling in recognition.
timeline.quote: held both wooden blades to his neck before he even had time to steady himself.

timeline.summary: Katsumasa, a Futurist, meets Kaito in a palace garden, sends a crane drone, and gives Kaito one.
timeline.quote: "Here. From one person the system failed to another."

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Katsumasa that his parents died after the lab accident and the unapproved med-tech.
timeline.quote: "My dad was arrested. He died in prison, and my mom died not long after."

timeline.summary: Light-Paws tells Kaito there will be no more sparring lessons and that he must choose a path, and Kaito refuses to be a samurai.
timeline.quote: "I don't want to be a samurai,"

timeline.summary: Light-Paws reveals the emperor told her of Kaito's ideas, and Kaito turns his back on his mentor.
timeline.quote: "What you mean," Kaito replied bitterly, "is that I have no place here."

timeline.summary: An alarm sounds in the palace and Kaito races over the rooftops to the emperor's chambers.
timeline.quote: Kaito took the fastest route to the emperor's chambers.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Kyodai writhing in distress and the emperor missing.
timeline.quote: But now Kyodai writhed in the water, lashing at the fog like she was hurting and confused.

timeline.summary: Kaito sees the man with the metal arm rise from the fog beside Kyodai.
timeline.quote: and a metal arm that pulsed with purple energy, the ends forming a monstrous claw.

timeline.summary: Kaito chases the intruder over the rooftops, but the man uses power over technology to yank Kaito from the roof and escapes.
timeline.quote: Kaito felt his wrist tug, and then he was yanked from the roof

timeline.summary: Kaito discovers the emperor is gone, and the Imperials blame the Uprisers.
timeline.quote: he realized the emperor was gone, too.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws suggests the Futurists are responsible and refuses to listen to Kaito's account.
timeline.quote: "Perhaps the Futurists are responsible for this.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws orders Kaito to his room, and Kaito resolves to leave the palace and search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.
timeline.quote: He would search Kamigawa for the man with the metal arm.

timeline.summary: Kaito, now a planeswalker, scouts Towashi with his tanuki drone Himoto and spots Imperial samurai outside an apartment with a window left ajar.
timeline.quote: Kaito nudged the drone skyward toward the height of the nearby buildings.

timeline.summary: Kaito sneaks into the apartment and meets his sister Eiko, who invited him by leaving the window open.
timeline.quote: turning to face his sister

timeline.summary: Eiko explains Risona's supporters and the Asari Uprisers grow bolder as the throne stays empty.
timeline.quote: The Asari Uprisers grow bolder every day.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Eiko argue over technology and balance, Kaito insisting technology levels the playing field.
timeline.quote: Technology levels the playing field.

timeline.summary: Using a noise suppressor, Eiko tells Kaito that Tameshi was seen meeting a man with a metal arm in the Undercity.
timeline.quote: Tameshi was seen meeting with a man in the Undercity. A man with a metal arm.

timeline.summary: Kaito decides to trust his sister enough to investigate and spy on his best friend.
timeline.quote: Kaito believed in his sister enough to follow the trail.

timeline.summary: For weeks Kaito tails Tameshi on Otawara and finds he is hiding secret deals and a secret project.
timeline.quote: And he'd watched the unregulated drones leave the compound and head straight for the Towashi Undercity.

timeline.summary: Kaito disables a security camera and breaks into Tameshi's compound while Tameshi is away.
timeline.quote: No camera would see him now

timeline.summary: In Tameshi's office Kaito finds a coded message to meet in the Undercity that night and a blueprint of a strange device.
timeline.quote: The meeting was happening tonight, and soon

timeline.summary: Kaito tracks Tameshi to the Undercity docks and sends Himoto into a warehouse laboratory.
timeline.quote: Silently, she flew toward the warehouse.

timeline.summary: Through the drone Kaito sees a chrome monster directing Reckoners to load specimens, with something screaming like a kami inside a container.
timeline.quote: They sounded like kami .

timeline.summary: A Reckoner smashes the beakers and the warehouse is set ablaze, destroying evidence as the vehicle leaves.
timeline.quote: threw it against the rest of the glass with force.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Tameshi mortally wounded by a metal arm, bleeding in the corner of the burning warehouse.
timeline.quote: The fabric of his robes had been slashed across the middle, clawed by a metal arm.

timeline.summary: Tameshi admits that lying to Kaito was his worst mistake.
timeline.quote: "I—I've made so many mistakes. But lying to you was the worst of them."

timeline.summary: Tameshi dies after whispering the name Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: "Tezzeret," Tameshi whispered like he was breaking a spell. And then he was gone.

timeline.summary: Kaito takes Tameshi's lab key card and leaves the blazing warehouse.
timeline.quote: he reached into his friend's pocket and removed the key card to his lab.

timeline.summary: Following weeks of searching for Tezzeret, Kaito travels into the nezumi swamp to find the child Nashi.
timeline.quote: But the key to finding Tezzeret was with the nezumi.

timeline.summary: The nezumi elder Mud-Tail refuses to talk to Kaito about Nashi.
timeline.quote: "You're not welcome here," she barked.

timeline.summary: Kaito sends Himoto to eavesdrop and learns a kami has carried word of Otawara to a nezumi who will warn someone there.
timeline.quote: Yes. I'll warn her.

timeline.summary: Kaito follows the nezumi's rabbit drone to Otawara.
timeline.quote: The tanuki followed, and Kaito headed in the direction of Otawara.

timeline.summary: Kaito fights a moonfolk with scrolls, who paralyzes him with a scroll spell.
timeline.quote: The moment she read the words, Kaito felt his entire body stiffen.

timeline.summary: Learning that Kaito knows of Tezzeret, the moonfolk releases the spell and introduces herself as Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: "I am Tamiyo," she said, voice as unwavering as steel.

timeline.summary: Kaito realizes Tamiyo is a planeswalker, and meets her son Nashi.
timeline.quote: "You're a planeswalker."

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tells Kaito that Tezzeret is the man with the metal arm and that he burned the nezumi village.
timeline.quote: Kaito learned that Tezzeret wasn't just a planeswalker—he was the planeswalker with the metal arm.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals the Reality Chip and that the Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same.
timeline.quote: "The Wanderer and the emperor are one and the same."

timeline.summary: Kaito resolves to steal the chip immediately rather than wait as Tamiyo urges.
timeline.quote: And he wasn't about to wait for Tamiyo's permission.

timeline.summary: Kaito uses Tameshi's key card to enter the lab and finds kami being drained of their essence.
timeline.quote: There were dozens of them—alive, but shriveled and dull, as if their very essence was being sucked out of them.

timeline.summary: Kaito steals the Reality Chip from its stand.
timeline.quote: So Kaito reached out, grabbed the Reality Chip from its stand, and shoved it in his pocket.

timeline.summary: Kaito encounters the monster who murdered Tameshi, who names himself Jin-Gitaxias and calls ninjas.
timeline.quote: The existence of a second Jin-Gitaxias on this plane is highly improbable

timeline.summary: Kaito fights the Undercity ninjas and escapes the lab with a smoke bomb.
timeline.quote: Black smoke exploded through the crowd

timeline.summary: Cornered by a dragon-shaped mech, Kaito chooses not to planeswalk with the chip.
timeline.quote: Leaving right now was too great a risk.

timeline.summary: The Reality Chip stirs, and a swordswoman cuts down the mech: the emperor, who is the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo hides the henchmen with an invisibility spell, and the three planeswalkers flee Otawara.
timeline.quote: the three planeswalkers fled from Otawara in silence.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Tamiyo, and the emperor arrive in the emperor's garden in Eiganjo, and the emperor enters Kyodai's temple.
timeline.quote: She turned for the porch, slid open the door to Kyodai's temple, and disappeared inside.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo find Kyodai reunited with the emperor, both in pain from the emperor's unstable spark.
timeline.quote: "Your spark is still unstable. You cannot remain on Kamigawa without help."

timeline.summary: The emperor reveals she has visions of the lab and that Jin-Gitaxias told Risona and the Uprisers of her return, so they will attack the palace.
timeline.quote: They plan to attack the palace imminently.

timeline.summary: The emperor tells Kaito she heard of his search across the planes and nearly met him many times.
timeline.quote: "Sometimes I was only a step behind you.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges destroying the Reality Chip, but Kaito objects and proposes destroying Tameshi's lab with Imperial detonators.
timeline.quote: "I'll destroy Tameshi's compound."

timeline.summary: The emperor approves the plan to destroy the compound, and agrees to remain in Eiganjo.
timeline.quote: "I will remain here," she said at last.

timeline.summary: Kaito promises the emperor to free any captive kami before setting off the charge.
timeline.quote: "You have my word," Kaito replied.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo return to Otawara and find the lab unlocked and the kami gone, their beds covered in metallic ash.
timeline.quote: The only evidence of a kami dematerializing.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret appears and tells them the experiments are about testing the connection between body and soul for Phyrexia, thanking them for bringing planeswalkers to the lab.
timeline.quote: And kami are much easier to come by than what Phyrexia really needs."

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo realize it was a trap and that the experiments are about planeswalkers, and the henchmen close in.
timeline.quote: It was a trap—and Kaito and Tamiyo had walked right into it.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret restrains Tamiyo with the lab's equipment and holds star-blades to Kaito's throat.
timeline.quote: a strip of metal equipment tore from the ceiling and wrapped itself around her hand like a monstrous restraint.

timeline.summary: Kaito throws a detonator at the machine room, but Tezzeret catches it and breaks it apart; Kaito is knocked unconscious.
timeline.quote: the detonator broke apart piece by piece, until it became nothing more than a pile of useless metal and microchips.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer cleaves Jin-Gitaxias with her sword and frees Kaito and Tamiyo from the surgical tables.
timeline.quote: The Wanderer brought her sword down like a blow from the heavens and cleaved Jin-Gitaxias from his neck to his chest.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer, Kaito and Tamiyo defeat the henchmen in the compound and hold Tezzeret paralyzed; the Wanderer decides to bring him to Kyodai.
timeline.quote: "Yes. We will decide his fate together."

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Tezzeret out with two crates.
timeline.quote: The impact knocked Tezzeret out cold.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer disables a surveillance mech and the group flies to Eiganjo on its back, carrying Tezzeret.
timeline.quote: The mech let out a ragged groan before lowering its body to the ground

timeline.summary: Tezzeret wakes and flings Kaito's smoke devices, then jumps from the mech; Tamiyo loses control and the group jumps before the mech crashes.
timeline.quote: the mech exploding against the side of an Imperial apartment.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tamiyo track Tezzeret as he heads for the emperor and fight him on the rooftops, with Eiko's dagger striking him.
timeline.quote: In his thigh was a gleaming dagger, the gold handle carved with the symbol of the Imperials.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret takes control of the chip on Tamiyo's hand, opens a portal and drags her away.
timeline.quote: Tezzeret yanked Tamiyo through the snapping light, and they both vanished from the rooftop.

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks Risona unconscious with a thrown rock and she is bound, ending the battle.
timeline.quote: something flew across the room and cracked against the side of her skull, knocking her unconscious.

timeline.summary: The emperor's spark takes hold and she vanishes from Kamigawa again.
timeline.quote: The spark took hold of her, and the emperor once again vanished from Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Light-Paws grows a new tail and Kaito and Eiko bow to the new Regent of Kamigawa.
timeline.quote: Kaito and his sister bowed to the new Regent of Kamigawa.

timeline.summary: Kaito says goodbye to Eiko, promising someday to try to reconcile with Light-Paws, and leaves to master planeswalking and find Tamiyo and the emperor.
timeline.quote: He would search the Multiverse for Tamiyo.

timeline.summary: Vraska, the Wanderer, Kaito, Tyvar and Lukka planeswalk in to join, and Kaya wraps the sylex for the journey.
timeline.quote: Soon, others began to planeswalk in.

timeline.summary: Kaito, hit by a wall of electrostatic wind on entering New Phyrexia, lies hypnotized on the metal beach, sure it is paradise.
timeline.quote: New Phyrexia wasn't a peril, it was a paradise, and he should just relax and let it wash over him

timeline.summary: The Wanderer shakes Kaito and strikes him in the face, breaking the hypnotic spell so that he hears the battle around him.
timeline.quote: he realized that what he'd taken for the sound of waves was actually the sound of metal clashing on metal

timeline.summary: Kaito finds his sword and tanuki drone gone, and the Wanderer begins flickering out of the plane.
timeline.quote: He grabbed instinctively for his sword

timeline.summary: Nahiri explains that a planar shield scattered the team on arrival, and that she shook off the sand's hypnosis because it is made of metal.
timeline.quote: we slammed into some sort of planar shield when we breached New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: Nahiri reveals a scratch on her neck and shows her blood still runs red, assuring Kaito she is fine.
timeline.quote: My blood's still red. No oil. I'll be fine.

timeline.summary: The group sets off across the metal desert toward the next landing zone, Nahiri warning that nothing Phyrexian can be trusted.
timeline.quote: You can't trust anything Phyrexian.

timeline.summary: The group finds a statue of an elf containing Zendikari hedron stone, suspended in cables, and Nahiri declares him one of their own.
timeline.quote: That's a Zendikari hedron.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Nahiri attack the living cables and cut the statue free, and the Wanderer kneels beside him.
timeline.quote: until, with a loud snapping sound, the last one broke and dumped him to the ground

timeline.summary: The Wanderer finally flickers away, unable to stay on the plane, having seen Kaito out of the first danger.
timeline.quote: He turned to the Wanderer, intending to say something to boost her spirits and bolster her strength.

timeline.summary: The group reaches a Mirran camp where the healer Melira greets them, explaining that Koth told them the planeswalkers were coming.
timeline.quote: You're the ones Koth told us were coming. I'm Melira.

timeline.summary: Melira collapses a section of the Facade with explosive charges, dropping the group down to Mirrodin.
timeline.quote: the ground dropped out from under their feet

timeline.summary: Nahiri catches the falling earth with her magic and slows their descent to the ground.
timeline.quote: the lithomancer caught hold of them and slowed their descent

timeline.summary: The group leaps into the lacuna to descend toward the Furnace Layer.
timeline.quote: Nahiri leapt without hesitation, and Kaito jumped after her.

timeline.summary: Kaya returns Kaito's sword to him and the tanuki drone leaps back to his shoulder.
timeline.quote: untying the blade and slapping the hilt into Kaito's palm

timeline.summary: Kaito and Tyvar prepare their weapons with hexgold.
timeline.quote: breaking his sword into its individual throwing stars

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

timeline.summary: Koth identifies Sheoldred's Coliseum and reveals that he once escaped it.
timeline.quote: No one exits the coliseum alive and unchanged. I escaped. Mostly.

timeline.summary: Jace runs into the coliseum and the others follow; Kaito wants to recover the sylex, but Elspeth insists on saving their own.
timeline.quote: What's the value of fighting at all, if we can't even make the stand to save our own?

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

timeline.summary: Kaito says he hopes Nahiri is dead rather than turned against them.
timeline.quote: I just hope she's dead,

timeline.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
timeline.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

timeline.summary: The team sees the invasion ships being prepared and Phyrexians massing along gangways connected to the World Tree.
timeline.quote: Phyrexians shuffled along the gangways, readying their assault on the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: Tyvar confronts Tibalt and tells Kaito to take the others on to the root source.
timeline.quote: Elspeth and I will handle the vermin.

timeline.summary: Kaito, Kaya and Jace leave, and Elspeth and Tyvar begin their battle against Ajani and Tibalt.
timeline.quote: and the battle was joined.

timeline.summary: Jace, Kaito and Kaya descend through the miniature citadel in the Seedcore, with Jace visibly being overtaken by wires.
timeline.quote: Jace didn't look good.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Kaya remark on the eerily sterile absence of spirits in Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia didn't release its victims, not even in death.

timeline.summary: Through a skylight they see the invasion ships filling with Phyrexian warriors.
timeline.quote: endless ranks of Phyrexian warriors in the red and white of Elesh Norn's faction filing into the increasingly gravid holds

timeline.summary: Kaito finds a hole leading to a disk near Realmbreaker's trunk, and they drop down to the point nearest the root.
timeline.quote: This was as close as they were going to come to the core root of the tree.

timeline.summary: Jace unpacks the sylex for the first time in Phyrexian air.
timeline.quote: He moved to unpack the sylex, revealing it to the Phyrexian air for the first time.

timeline.summary: Kaya urges Jace to wait, warning the blast could travel through the Omenpaths to every connected plane.
timeline.quote: We could blow up the Blind Eternities.

timeline.summary: Kaya grabs Jace's wrist and, with Kaito, draws a weapon against him to stop him.
timeline.quote: She pulled a dagger from her belt.

timeline.summary: Kaya discovers that the Jace she attacked is an illusion and that two of three Jaces are fakes.
timeline.quote: two of the Jaces didn't have spirits.

timeline.summary: Kaito hits Jace's arm with shuriken, dispelling the false images; Kaya moves on the sylex.
timeline.quote: Producing a handful of shuriken from inside his shirt, he flung them at the true Jace

timeline.summary: Realmbreaker pulses and its branches wink out, carrying Phyrexian invaders through the Omenpaths to other planes.
timeline.quote: Each branch, with its heavy burden of Phyrexian invaders, had reached for another plane

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn enters with Phyrexian warriors, Tamiyo, and Jace's risen corpse, welcoming the survivors to Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Welcome, weary travelers, to Phyrexia,

timeline.summary: Compleated Nahiri and Nissa are revealed beside Elesh Norn.
timeline.quote: Nahiri had clearly not survived her fall.

timeline.summary: The survivors refuse to yield, and Elesh Norn begins the invasion.
timeline.quote: and the invasion began.

timeline.summary: Norn confronts three captive planeswalkers, Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar, who defy her offer.
timeline.quote: Behold the glory of New Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Norn has Nahiri encase the three planeswalkers in stone and tells them to be her prophets.
timeline.quote: You shall be the prophets of our coming,

timeline.summary: Norn lets the captive planeswalkers escape deliberately so they can spread her gospel.
timeline.quote: Elesh Norn counts on them escaping.

timeline.summary: Tyvar's arrival heralds the return of survivors from New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: the brash war-horn boom of Tyvar's arrival falls like an axe between them

timeline.summary: Kaya, Kaito and Tyvar report that Phyrexia has corrupted the World Tree and is using it to invade the planes.
timeline.quote: They're using it to invade the other planes.

timeline.summary: The survivors reveal Jace did not return, having become one of them, and Nahiri was taken.
timeline.quote: He became one of them,

timeline.summary: Chandra proposes returning to New Phyrexia to take down the World Tree, and Kaya, Vivien, Tyvar and Kaito refuse.
timeline.quote: There must be some other way to take the World Tree down.

timeline.summary: Kaito saves Kaya and the boy by slowing their fall with telekinesis.
timeline.quote: His telekinesis is barely holding them up

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Kaya that Tamiyo has opened the scroll and is destroying Boseiju.
timeline.quote: And worse, Tamiyo did it. Opened a scroll.

timeline.summary: Kaito starts to climb Boseiju to confront Tamiyo and meets Nashi, who asks to try to reach his mother.
timeline.quote: That's my mom up there.

timeline.summary: Kaito gives Nashi a repulsor and they climb Boseiju together toward Tamiyo.
timeline.quote: Walk in the direction you want to go.

timeline.summary: Nashi calls to Tamiyo, who answers with his name before her body snaps around and she attacks.
timeline.quote: A shard of metal shoots toward them

timeline.summary: Tamiyo urges Nashi to join Phyrexia, and Kaito tells him to retreat as they fight.
timeline.quote: In the light of New Phyrexia, all are one.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo overpowers Kaito with scrolls and hangs him above Towashi, offering him surrender.
timeline.quote: Kaito flips feet over head before he knows what's happened, dangling far above Towashi.

timeline.summary: Kaito cuts himself free and is caught by Kyodai bearing the Wanderer.
timeline.quote: it's the emperor.

timeline.summary: Nashi, grieving, is comforted by Kaito, Kaya, the Wanderer and Kyodai.
timeline.quote: Even Kyodai wraps around them all.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo's memory, a being of floating characters, speaks and reveals she was sealed in the scroll for such a death.
timeline.quote: I am what remains of Tamiyo—her story unending.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer explains that Tamiyo's last act was a request that her missed shards and mouthed words showed, so the memory is true.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo was making a request, in the only way she could.

timeline.summary: Imperial forces with giant mechs gather to counter the Phyrexian assault as Kaito reflects that Tamiyo fell but Nashi lived.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo fell—but Nashi lived.

timeline.summary: A ghostly branch of Vitu-Ghazi seizes Kaya's waist; she remembers Kaito's lesson and turns solid to escape it.
timeline.quote: Something wrapped around her waist, jerking her to a stop.

timeline.summary: Jace says goodbye to Kaya and Kaito and chooses not to command them to sleep.
timeline.quote: His last kindness in all their last breaths will allow them their agency.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn offers his friends a place among the One, and Tyvar, Kaito and Kaya refuse.
timeline.quote: "Enemies it is," Elesh Norn concludes.

timeline.summary: Now, Kaito sneaks through Otawara past the Soratami drones to steal an iron scroll.
timeline.quote: Pressing himself flat against an alley wall, Kaito Shizuki watched a drone soar by

timeline.summary: Kaito knocks out a guard at the changing of the guard and picks the lock of the treasure room.
timeline.quote: Kaito moved behind the guard and hit him on the back of the head with the pommel of his sword.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds the scroll protected by a spider kami's spirit web and asks Himoto to unweave it.
timeline.quote: A spider kami hung above the scroll in a delicate spirit web

timeline.summary: The white-haired Wanderer appears behind Kaito and blocks his blade with her own.
timeline.quote: The white-haired woman standing behind him offered a slight smile, her sword still lifted to prevent him from completing a stroke.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer tells Kaito she needs his help because Nashi is in trouble.
timeline.quote: I came because I need your help. Nashi's in trouble.

timeline.summary: Kaito, with the scroll in hand, tells the Wanderer he will return it to Genku, Tamiyo's widower, by morning.
timeline.quote: Genku will have his lost wife's scroll back in the library come morning.

timeline.summary: The Wanderer reveals Nashi has been missing for three months.
timeline.quote: Three months.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds Tyvar and recruits him for the rescue; Tyvar eagerly agrees.
timeline.quote: When do we leave?

timeline.summary: Tyvar vouches for Niko Aris, a former planeswalker, as the defensive fighter Kaito needs.
timeline.quote: I think I may have just the hero that you need

timeline.summary: Niko shows their shard magic, says the invasion did not take it, and agrees to come along.
timeline.quote: Can't let the Planeswalkers have all the fun.

timeline.summary: Kaito arrives on Ravnica and wonders why he kept his spark when so many others lost theirs; Niko is bitter at their loss.
timeline.quote: Kaito stepped out of forever onto the streets of Ravnica

timeline.summary: Kaito meets Zimone, a Strixhaven student sent by Niv-Mizzet to wait for him.
timeline.quote: I'm Zimone. I'm a student? Quandrix College, at Strixhaven University.

timeline.summary: Zimone leads the group to a courtyard where Kaito presents Tyvar and Niko to the dragon Niv-Mizzet.
timeline.quote: The alley ended in a small courtyard, dominated by a massive red dragon lounging on the far side like a cat

timeline.summary: Zimone reports that Nashi's drones recorded a house with distorted space on the other side.
timeline.quote: Just a house, perfectly normal, if in need of a good cleaning service.

timeline.summary: The team takes Etrata's monitoring devices and files through the door into the House.
timeline.quote: One by one, the group filed inside.

timeline.summary: The party moves down a dusty hallway and discovers the door they came through has vanished.
timeline.quote: The door's gone

timeline.summary: Kaito reads the air in the parlor and concludes someone was recently there.
timeline.quote: I don't know if Nashi was here recently, but someone was

timeline.summary: Niko proposes a right-hand search pattern, as in Theros labyrinth exercises, and leads the party.
timeline.quote: We take the right-hand turn and keep following to the right until and unless we wind up back where we started.

timeline.summary: The party finds an abandoned funfair in a cornfield beyond glass doors, but Zimone shows the sky is a glass ceiling, so it is still the House.
timeline.quote: If they were indoors, there could be no breeze, and without a breeze, why was it moving?

timeline.summary: The Wanderer refuses Kaito's idea of scouting the rooftops, insisting the group stay visible to one another.
timeline.quote: You were the one who realized we had to stay ever visible to one another.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Niko realize the doorway moved and skewed Niko's aim, so the trap was deliberate.
timeline.quote: The doorway moved as Tyvar passed through it.

timeline.summary: Kaito steps toward the doorway and the floor opens into a toothed mouth; he falls into blackness as the Wanderer fails to catch him.
timeline.quote: The floor he stepped onto opened like the mouth of a lamprey

timeline.summary: Kaito falls through the floor with Himoto clinging to him.
timeline.quote: Himoto's claws dug into his shoulder as she anchored herself, refusing to be separated from him

timeline.summary: Kaito lands on a forest floor beneath the ballroom, unhurt despite the fall.
timeline.quote: his descent ended in a hard impact with what felt like a forest floor.

timeline.summary: A dragon appears overhead and burns the dying forest.
timeline.quote: The shadow swooped by again, this time accompanied by a brilliant burst of flame

timeline.summary: The dragon's fire engulfs Kaito, and he finds himself on a burned plain beside a burning city, in what feels like a staged performance.
timeline.quote: it was a performance being put on for Kaito's benefit—or for the House's.

timeline.summary: Dozens of dragons circle a burning city in the vision.
timeline.quote: Dragons wheeled through the sky overhead, dozens of them, their attention fixed on a burning city.

timeline.summary: The vision tears like paper and Kaito stands in a basement with a dying candle light.
timeline.quote: he appeared to be standing in an underground room with rough stone walls and a staircase in one corner

timeline.summary: Kaito senses someone approaching and punches Jace in the face.
timeline.quote: he whirled, driving his right fist square into the face of the slender, dark-haired man who'd been walking up behind him.

timeline.summary: Kaito and Jace quarrel over their fight on New Phyrexia and the sylex.
timeline.quote: Last time I saw you, we were trying to kill each other on New Phyrexia!

timeline.summary: A groaning sound fills the basement and Kaito and Jace stand back to back, agreeing to fight later.
timeline.quote: Jace and Kaito both stiffened, instinctively falling into position back to back

timeline.summary: A tentacled nightmare crawls from the basement wall toward Jace and Kaito.
timeline.quote: some terrible, shapeless, tentacled thing began to crawl out and into the room where they both stood.

timeline.summary: Jace reads the nightmare's mind and says it is a nightmare given substance.
timeline.quote: This is a nightmare given substance.

timeline.summary: Kaito deflects its tentacle with a wall of floor debris.
timeline.quote: the little flecks of stone that littered the floor rose up in a wall of debris that blocked the strike

timeline.summary: Jace apologizes for vanishing after the invasion and says he is searching for Vraska.
timeline.quote: I've been traveling with Vraska and our new companion.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaito fall into a pit of stinging gel.
timeline.quote: the floor gave way beneath their feet and they fell, not into nothingness, but into a pit filled with some thick, gelatinous substance

timeline.summary: Manacles clasp Kaito's ankles as he touches a rung.
timeline.quote: shouted as he felt manacles clasp around his ankles.

timeline.summary: Himoto picks the locks on Jace's shackles.
timeline.quote: Himoto began working at the locks on Jace's shackles, manipulating the tumblers until they clicked open.

timeline.summary: A projection on the ceiling shows Vraska shielding a small creature from blade-bodied monsters.
timeline.quote: There, projected on the ceiling, was Vraska, shielding a small, orange-furred creature with her body

timeline.summary: Jace abandons Kaito in the pit, climbing the rungs and triggering the manacles that pull Kaito down.
timeline.quote: Before Kaito realized what was happening, Jace began to climb.

timeline.summary: Drowning in gel, Kaito planeswalks back to Ravnica.
timeline.quote: and planeswalked away, back to Ravnica, back to the beginning, where he might yet survive.

timeline.summary: Kaito appears in the Ravnica alley where he first met Zimone.
timeline.quote: The sounds of Ravnica were like an assault after the eerie quiet of Duskmourn.

timeline.summary: Kaito finds bloodstained wood in his hand and discovers he cannot planeswalk back to the House.
timeline.quote: A piece of bloodstained wood rested in his hand, a parting gift from Duskmourn.

timeline.summary: Kaito tells Niv-Mizzet that Jace left him.
timeline.quote: He said he was sorry, and he left me.

timeline.summary: Aminatou says the House now knows Kaito and does not want him inside.
timeline.quote: The trouble isn't in you. It's in the House.

timeline.summary: Proft offers Kaito an idea to help rescue his friends.
timeline.quote: If you would come with me, I think I have an idea that might help us

timeline.summary: Kaito stabs Valgavoth in the chest through the wall with his katana.
timeline.quote: The blade of a katana protruded from it, glistening with ichor and hemolymph

timeline.summary: Kaito stands before a blue-white door of light, an artificial Omenpath.
timeline.quote: Behind him on the wall was a door formed from blue-white light

timeline.summary: The team escapes through the door, with Kaito covering Tyvar against a nightmare.
timeline.quote: Together they ran for the door.

timeline.summary: Kaito explains the artificial Omenpath is made of his spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting and a piece of the House.
timeline.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting, and a piece of the House that I took with me when I had to planeswalk away.

timeline.summary: The team steps out onto Ravnica.
timeline.quote: stepping with them out into the light of the Ravnican afternoon.

timeline.summary: Back on Kamigawa, Nashi tells children the story of their adventure.
timeline.quote: watching as Nashi spun the story of their adventures to a crowd of rapt youngsters.

timeline.summary: Kaito pursues a personal agenda of technological progress on Kamigawa, breaking rules to make the world better for himself and his family.
timeline.quote: He pursues a personal agenda of technological progress on his home plane of Kamigawa

relations.note: bonds with him and chooses to search for the emperor together
relations.quote: "Okay. I guess it's you and me from now on."
Light-Paws was their teacher, but she was also the closest thing they had to a guardian.

relations.note: friend and mentor over the years
relations.quote: He'd been both a friend and a mentor over the years.

relations.note: the kami who sparked Kaito and takes drone and mask form
relations.quote: she represented the kami who had changed Kaito's life forever.

relations.note: they agree to work together to find Tezzeret
relations.quote: And perhaps you and I are meant to be allies."

relations.note: childhood friend who fights beside him
relations.quote: She had been able to hold on long enough to see her childhood friend out of the initial danger

relations.note: stand together against Jace and Phyrexia

relations.quote: Fighting against peace to maintain your loneliness.

relations.note: Nashi says his relationship with Kaito is complicated.
Kaito is among the friends Jace tries to persuade.
relations.quote: his allies, his friends, Kaya and Kaito

relations.note: Rides on his shoulder and helps with the heist.
relations.quote: On Kaito's shoulder, Himoto adjusted her position

relations.note: Taught him to read the air.
relations.quote: Under his tutelage, Kaito had learned how to step into a room

relations.note: Companion who is always with him.
relations.quote: Himoto was with him, as she always was, as she always would be.

relations.note: Latches onto him in the pit.
relations.quote: He felt Himoto latch onto his leg.

relations.note: Contributes mind magic to the artificial Omenpath.
relations.quote: My spark, Proft's mind magic, Aminatou's fate-twisting

pages_say.description: A young former Imperial samurai trainee working as a Hyozan Reckoner to find the missing emperor; after bonding with Himoto he becomes a planeswalker.
An orphaned Imperial student with telekinesis who befriends the emperor, is disbelieved about the man with the metal arm, and leaves the palace to hunt the man with the metal arm.
A planeswalker and former Imperial trainee who searches the Multiverse for the missing emperor and the man with the metal arm.
A planeswalker and Futurist who hunts the man with the metal arm to bring the emperor home, and steals the Reality Chip.
A planeswalker who returns the emperor to Eiganjo, then goes to destroy Tameshi's compound and is captured in a trap.
A planeswalker who helps defend Eiganjo and resolves to search the Multiverse for Tamiyo and the emperor.
A young man with a shorn head who arrives with the Wanderer.
A planeswalker from Kamigawa and part of the strike team, who wakes on the sands of New Phyrexia stripped of his sword and his tanuki drone.
A planeswalker from Kamigawa who recovers his sword and tanuki drone and hones his blade with hexgold.
A planeswalker from Kamigawa who fights with a throwing-star sword and tanuki drone.
A planeswalker from Kamigawa whose telekinesis removes Phyrexian oil from the group.
A planeswalker from Kamigawa who fights with shuriken and telekinesis and refuses to risk Kamigawa.
A planeswalker held captive in the sanctum and released as a messenger.
A planeswalker who returned from New Phyrexia wounded.
A planeswalker defending Kamigawa, who takes Nashi up Boseiju to face Tamiyo and whose telekinesis saves Kaya.
A friend of Kaya whose lesson about moving between raindrops she recalls.
A planeswalker with whom Nashi has a complicated relationship, and who Nashi believes did not listen to him.
A planeswalker and Jace's friend, who declines Norn's invitation casually.
A Kamigawan planeswalker who still has his spark; he steals back an iron scroll that was Tamiyo's and then assembles a team to rescue Nashi.
A planeswalker who leads the rescue party and reads air movement to sense recent presence; he falls through a trapdoor in the floor.
A planeswalker who falls through the floor, endures a vision of a dragon-burned forest and city, and meets Jace in a basement.
A planeswalker who fights a nightmare with Jace, is abandoned in a gel pit and planeswalks back to Ravnica.
A planeswalker who escapes to Ravnica, finds he cannot planeswalk back to the House, and hears from Niv-Mizzet's team.
A planeswalker who returns through an artificial Omenpath and stabs Valgavoth.
A master ninja and planeswalker with innate telekinetic powers who pursues technological progress on Kamigawa.
